caption: The worked example in one picture: 200 slots sending 60 B every 5 minutes give 320 bit/s average uplink and 3.456 MB per day. The two conversion steps are highlighted: divide messages per hour by 3600 to get per second, and multiply bytes by 8 to get bits.

spec.title: Worked example: 200 slots, 60 B every 5 min
spec.aria: A vertical flowchart of the parking worked example: 200 slots with 60-byte messages every 5 minutes give 12 messages per slot per hour, 2400 messages per hour, 0.6667 messages per second, 480 bits per message, 320 bit/s average uplink, and 3.456 MB per day.
